social.title: Drag Brunch in Fitzroy
social.description: Clap along to lip-sync numbers between courses at a drag brunch, queens working the tables as mimosas keep coming.
social.bonus: Tip a performer and get pulled into the number

social.title: Live Gig at Cherry Bar
social.description: Squeeze into the tiny, rock-poster-plastered Cherry Bar down AC/DC Lane for a live band louder than the venue is big.
social.bonus: Get as close to the stage as the crowd allows

social.title: Stand-Up Comedy Night at The Comics Lounge
social.description: Grab a table at The Comics Lounge for a stacked line-up of stand-up, heckling optional but encouraged.
social.bonus: Sit in the front three rows and risk getting picked on

social.title: Trivia Night at The Napier Hotel
social.description: Cram around a sticky pub table at The Napier Hotel and battle it out for bragging rights at trivia night.
social.bonus: Bet the table a round of drinks you'll get the final question right

social.title: Board Game Night at a Tabletop Cafe
social.description: Pull a game off the towering shelf at a tabletop cafe and go head-to-head over coffee and snacks until someone flips the board.
social.bonus: Let a stranger at the next table join your game

social.title: Salsa Dancing Class and Social
social.description: Learn a basic salsa turn pattern in a beginner class, then stay for the social dancing that spills past midnight.
social.bonus: Dance with three different partners before the night ends

social.title: Queen Victoria Market Night Market
social.description: Graze food-truck laksa and craft beer under fairy lights while a band plays at the Wednesday Night Market.
social.bonus: Try a dish from a cuisine you've never eaten before

social.title: Laneway Bar Hop Through Centre Place
social.description: Duck through Centre Place and Degraves Street's hidden doorways, hopping between tiny laneway bars stacked on top of cafes.
social.bonus: Find a bar with no sign out front

social.title: MCG Stadium and Sports Museum Tour
social.description: Walk through the changerooms and out onto the hallowed turf of the MCG on a behind-the-scenes stadium tour.
social.bonus: Stand where the premiership cup gets lifted and take a photo

social.title: Karaoke Night at Karaoke Box
social.description: Book a private room at Karaoke Box and belt out duets with friends until your throat gives out.
social.bonus: Sing a song completely outside your comfort zone

social.title: Live AFL Match at the MCG
social.description: Roar with 80,000 people at the MCG as the ball bounces and a footy match swings on every kick.
social.bonus: Learn the club song of the team you're cheering for before the final siren

social.title: Rooftop Drinks at Naked For Satan
social.description: Ride the rickety lift to the rooftop of Naked For Satan for pintxos skewers and a wraparound view of Fitzroy's rooftops.
social.bonus: Order a skewer of the strangest-sounding pintxo on the menu

adventure.title: Treetop Ropes Course at Trees Adventure
adventure.description: Zip between treetop platforms and swing across rope bridges high in the eucalypt canopy of the Dandenong Ranges.
adventure.bonus: Complete the hardest zipline without hesitating at the platform

adventure.title: Ice Skating at Docklands
adventure.description: Wobble, then glide, across the rink at the Docklands ice skating pop-up under the winter lights.
adventure.bonus: Attempt a spin, however small, before you leave the ice

adventure.title: Twilight Kayak Tour on the Yarra
adventure.description: Paddle beneath the glowing city skyline with Kayak Melbourne, the CBD towers lighting up overhead as dusk settles.
adventure.bonus: Take a photo of the skyline from water level

adventure.title: SUP Yoga Class at Elwood Foreshore
adventure.description: Hold a downward dog on a paddleboard off Elwood foreshore, balance tested with every wave that rolls under you.
adventure.bonus: Try not to fall in during the balance poses

adventure.title: Morning Run Around The Tan Track
adventure.description: Loop the 3.8km gravel circuit of The Tan alongside hundreds of other Melburnians getting their morning kilometres in.
adventure.bonus: Beat your usual pace on at least one section

adventure.title: Ghost Tour of the Old Melbourne Gaol
adventure.description: Creep through the condemned cells of Old Melbourne Gaol after dark, torchlight flickering over the gallows where Ned Kelly was hanged.
adventure.bonus: Ask the guide for the goriest story they know

adventure.title: Guided E-Bike and Wine Tasting Tour of the Yarra Valley
adventure.description: Cruise between cellar doors on an e-bike through the Yarra Valley's vine rows, a gourmet lunch waiting at the halfway mark.
adventure.bonus: Pedal the last stretch without the electric assist

adventure.title: Hike the 1000 Steps Kokoda Track Memorial Walk
adventure.description: Grind up the timber-stepped Kokoda Track Memorial Walk through the Dandenong Ranges rainforest, calves burning by the top.
adventure.bonus: Read one of the memorial plaques along the track

adventure.title: Drop-In Beach Volleyball at St Kilda Beach
adventure.description: Dive into the sand courts at St Kilda Beach for a pickup game of beach volleyball as the sun goes down.
adventure.bonus: Play a point barefoot even if the sand is scorching

adventure.title: Stand-Up Paddleboarding on Albert Park Lake
adventure.description: Balance across the flat water of Albert Park Lake on a stand-up paddleboard, the F1 grandstands looming in the background.
adventure.bonus: Try to stand for a full minute without wobbling

adventure.title: Intro Rock Climbing at Hardrock Climbing Gym
adventure.description: Chalk up and scale the walls at Hardrock Climbing Gym, working out a new route to the top rung by rung.
adventure.bonus: Attempt the hardest route on the wall, even if you fall

adventure.title: Great Ocean Road & Twelve Apostles Day Tour
adventure.description: Chase the coastline past cliffside lookouts to stand before the Twelve Apostles as the Southern Ocean crashes below.
adventure.bonus: Watch the limestone stacks change color as the sun moves

adventure.title: Dolphin-Spotting Kayak Tour on Port Phillip Bay
adventure.description: Paddle out from Port Melbourne into the bay on the hunt for the resident pod of wild dolphins.
adventure.bonus: Keep your eyes on the water for a fin

adventure.title: Street Art Photo Walk Through Hosier Lane
adventure.description: Wander Hosier Lane's ever-changing layers of spray-painted murals, camera ready before the next masterpiece gets painted over.
adventure.bonus: Find and photograph a piece by an artist you don't recognize

adventure.title: Safari Tour at Werribee Open Range Zoo
adventure.description: Roll through open grasslands on a safari truck as rhinos and giraffes graze metres from the rail.
adventure.bonus: Get a photo with an animal that isn't a lion or giraffe

adventure.title: Bouldering Session at Northside Boulders
adventure.description: Chalk up and work a bouldering circuit at Northside Boulders, no ropes, just crash pads and problem-solving.
adventure.bonus: Send a route you failed on your first attempt

adventure.title: Bike Ride Along Beach Road to Brighton
adventure.description: Ride the Beach Road bike path from St Kilda down to Brighton, salt air and bay views the whole way.
adventure.bonus: Stop for a swim halfway if the water looks good

adventure.title: Cycle the Capital City Trail Along the Yarra
adventure.description: Pedal a stretch of the Capital City Trail along the Yarra, weaving past rowers and riverside parks.
adventure.bonus: Stop at a park bench for a break you didn't plan on taking

adventure.title: Eureka Skydeck 88 & The Edge
adventure.description: Step into the glass cube of The Edge, 88 floors above the Yarra, and watch it slide out over open air with nothing but glass beneath your feet.
adventure.bonus: Stand dead center of The Edge and look straight down

adventure.title: Learn to Surf at Torquay on the Great Ocean Road
adventure.description: Paddle out at Torquay with a surf instructor and catch your first whitewash wave on the edge of the Great Ocean Road.
adventure.bonus: Stand up on a wave, even for just a second

adventure.title: Steam Train Ride on Puffing Billy
adventure.description: Chug through fern gullies and over the timber Trestle Bridge aboard a century-old steam train, legs dangling out the window.
adventure.bonus: Dangle your legs out the window like the postcard photo

chill.title: Float Tank Session
chill.description: Drift weightless in total darkness inside an Epsom-salt float tank, every muscle finally letting go.
chill.bonus: Try to empty your mind for the first ten minutes without checking the time

chill.title: Sunset Stroll Through the Royal Botanic Gardens
chill.description: Follow the looping paths of the Royal Botanic Gardens as the light turns gold over the lake and the flying foxes stir.
chill.bonus: Find a bench with a view of the skyline through the trees

chill.title: Rooftop Cinema Under the Stars
chill.description: Climb to a rooftop deck above Curtin House for a movie under the open sky, skyline glittering past the screen.
chill.bonus: Grab a blanket if the night turns cold and don't complain about it

chill.title: Little Penguins at St Kilda Pier
chill.description: Wait out the last light at St Kilda Pier's breakwater as a colony of little penguins waddles ashore for the night.
chill.bonus: Stay silent and still so you don't spook them

chill.title: Free Wander Through NGV International
chill.description: Drift through the free galleries of NGV International, past the stained-glass ceiling and the famous water wall out front.
chill.bonus: Trail your fingers through the water wall on the way in

chill.title: Picnic Afternoon in Fitzroy Gardens
chill.description: Spread a blanket under the elm avenues of Fitzroy Gardens with a market haul of cheese, bread and fruit.
chill.bonus: Visit Captain Cook's Cottage tucked in the corner of the gardens

chill.title: Sunset Sit on St Kilda Beach
chill.description: Sink into the sand at St Kilda Beach and watch the sun drop behind the pier as the city lights start to flicker on.
chill.bonus: Stay until the very last sliver of sun disappears

chill.title: Photo Walk Past the Brighton Bathing Boxes
chill.description: Stroll the sand past the candy-colored row of Brighton Bathing Boxes, each one painted a different story.
chill.bonus: Pick your favorite bathing box and say why

chill.title: Sunset Sailing Cruise on Port Phillip Bay
chill.description: Lean back against the rail as a yacht tacks across Port Phillip Bay, the skyline turning pink and gold behind the sails.
chill.bonus: Take the helm for a few minutes if the skipper lets you

chill.title: Reading Session in the State Library's Dome
chill.description: Settle into the octagonal reading room beneath the State Library's domed ceiling, surrounded by the hush of turning pages.
chill.bonus: Read a section of the newspaper you never normally check

chill.title: Sunrise Yoga in Edinburgh Gardens
chill.description: Roll out a mat on the grass of Edinburgh Gardens for a sunrise yoga class as Fitzroy slowly wakes up around you.
chill.bonus: Hold the final pose a few extra breaths longer than everyone else

chill.title: Day Trip to Peninsula Hot Springs
chill.description: Ease between a maze of geothermal pools at Peninsula Hot Springs, steam rising over the Mornington Peninsula bushland.
chill.bonus: Try the coldest plunge pool before you leave

foodie.title: Gelato Crawl Down Lygon Street
foodie.description: Sample your way down Lygon Street's gelato bars, one small cup at a time, until you've found your favorite flavor.
foodie.bonus: Try a flavor you've never seen before

foodie.title: Tasting Menu at Attica
foodie.description: Work through Attica's degustation of native Australian ingredients, a menu built around what's growing in the chef's own garden.
foodie.bonus: Ask the waiter to explain the story behind the strangest-sounding course

foodie.title: Full-Day Wine Tasting Tour of the Yarra Valley
foodie.description: Cellar-door hop through the Yarra Valley's rolling vineyards, swirling glasses of pinot noir with a long lunch in between.
foodie.bonus: Ask a winemaker what vintage they'd pick for themselves

foodie.title: Hands-On Dumpling Making Class
foodie.description: Pleat your own pork and chive dumplings from scratch in a hands-on class before steaming and eating your handiwork.
foodie.bonus: Make one dumpling shaped like something ridiculous

foodie.title: Wine and Cheese Night at Bar Lourinha
foodie.description: Order a round of Spanish tapas and natural wine at Bar Lourinha, a sliver of a bar tucked down a CBD laneway.
foodie.bonus: Let the bartender pick your wine pairing blind

foodie.title: Saturday Morning Browse at Prahran Market
foodie.description: Weave through butchers, bakers and fishmongers hawking their Saturday-morning best at Prahran Market.
foodie.bonus: Chat with a stallholder about how they source their produce

foodie.title: High Tea at Hopetoun Tea Rooms
foodie.description: Stack a tiered tray with finger sandwiches and scones under the gilded ceilings of Hopetoun Tea Rooms in the Block Arcade.
foodie.bonus: Eat the scone with jam first, cream second, or start a debate about it

foodie.title: Modern Thai Dinner at Chin Chin
foodie.description: Squeeze onto a communal bench at Chin Chin for smoky, share-style modern Thai plates under the roar of the open kitchen.
foodie.bonus: Order the dish the table next to you is eating

foodie.title: Breakfast Crawl Through Queen Victoria Market
foodie.description: Graze your way through Queen Victoria Market's deli hall, hot jam doughnuts and bratwurst rolls in hand before the crowds arrive.
foodie.bonus: Buy something from a stall you've never noticed before

foodie.title: Dim Sims and Doughnuts at South Melbourne Market
foodie.description: Queue for a dozen dim sims and a jam-and-cream doughnut, then eat both standing up in the market aisles.
foodie.bonus: Eat the doughnut before you've paid for anything else

foodie.title: Coffee Flight Tasting at Market Lane Coffee
foodie.description: Work through a guided flight of single-origin pours at Market Lane Coffee, cupping notes you never knew coffee could carry.
foodie.bonus: Guess the tasting notes before the barista reveals them

foodie.title: Dumpling Feast in Melbourne Chinatown
foodie.description: Pile a lazy Susan with pan-fried pork dumplings and xiao long bao at a Chinatown institution on Little Bourke Street.
foodie.bonus: Order the dish with the longest name on the menu
